b: Maria Teresa Pirrigheddu and Vieri Mura
An album of Sardinian cantu a chiterra proves softly spoken but full of character
Rundinas by Maria Teresa Pirrigheddu & Vieri Mura

The path to Rundinas, a collection of songs in the cantu a chiterra style of northern Sardinia, began with a research project. Vieri Mura, an Italian musician, composer and researcher of Sardinian heritage, interviewed Maria Teresa Pirrigheddu, a known singer of cantu a chiterra, as part of an ethnography of Sardinian music.

The friendship that followed from these meetings eventually produced Rundinas (‘swallows’, like the birds that return to Sardinia), with lyrics pulled from Pirrigheddu’s favourite traditional songs and poems, set to music by Vieri.
